name: World
overview: Scripture reveals the world as both the object of God's immense love, demonstrated through the giving of His Son for eternal life (John 3:16), and a realm marked by opposition to Christ and His followers (John 15:18). Believers are called to resist conformity to worldly patterns and instead be transformed by renewing their minds to align with God's perfect will (Romans 12:2), setting their affections on heavenly things rather than earthly concerns (Colossians 3:2). While Jesus acknowledged that His kingdom is not of this world (John 18:36), He also assured His followers that though tribulation will come, they can have peace because He has overcome the world (John 16:33).
